query: What explicit school and classroom selection criteria, exclusion rules, and recruitment-bias mitigation steps will we apply across urban/rural and grade strata?

response.query: What explicit school and classroom selection criteria, exclusion rules, and recruitment-bias mitigation steps will we apply across urban/rural and grade strata?
response.answer: Schools will be selected based on geographic diversity and grade levels, excluding those with recent major renovations. Recruitment will use random sampling to mitigate bias. Urban and rural schools will be proportionately represented.

results.content: Hay Street Road Widening Policy Area 2.3 Relationship to other Planning Documents This policy should be read in conjunction with the City of Perth Local Planning Scheme No. 3 (LPS3) and other relevant legislation and local planning policies including: • New Street Alignment Local Law 2005 (as amended) • Building Heights and Setbacks Local Planning Policy • General Design Local Planning Policy • Residential Design Local Planning Policy • Heritage Local Planning Policy • Character Area Local Planning Policies Agenda Briefing Session Agenda 19 August 2025 Item 11.1 Attachment A - Draft Hay Street Road Reserve Widening Local Planning Policy Page 17 of 268 Draft Hay Road Reserve Widening Local Planning Policy - August 2025 4 • Heritage Area Local Planning Policies Where this policy is inconsistent with LPS3, the provisions of LPS3 prevail to the extent of any inconsistency.

results.title: Energy & Power - Mercer Capital
results.content: Mercer Capital provides a comprehensive suite of valuation, financial reporting, transaction advisory, dispute resolution, and family business advisory services. Mercer Capital is a valuation and advisory firm. For more than forty years, we have served as a trusted and independent resource for owners, boards, management teams, fiduciaries, and professional advisors on matters such as valuing a company, evaluating a transaction, resolving a dispute, planning for succession, or assessing the financial aspects of strategic decisions. Providing a broad overview of our latest thinking relating to all aspects of business valuation and advisory services written by the professionals of Mercer Capital. From traditional oil and gas operations to emerging alternative and renewable platforms, Mercer Capital provides independent valuation and financial advisory services across the Energy sector. The energy and power sector encompasses companies involved in the production, transportation, generation, and distribution of energy across traditional and emerging sources. ##### Oil & Gas. Mercer Capital provides oil & gas companies, oil & gas servicers, and mineral & royalty owners with corporate valuation, litigation support, transaction advisory, and other related services.
